subject: Kan niet inloggen
reason: This is a standard how-to question regarding forgotten passwords covered fully by FAQ F01. Priority is P4 as the standard self-service password reset procedure is available.
draft_reply:
Hoi Marloes,

Je kunt je wachtwoord opnieuw instellen door naar app.roosterly.nl/login te gaan en te klikken op "Wachtwoord vergeten" (Forgot password). Vul daar je e-mailadres in. De resetlink is 60 minuten geldig. Ontvang je binnen 10 minuten geen e-mail? Controleer dan even je spambox.

Met vriendelijke groet,
Team Roosterly
reply_en:
Hi Marloes,

You can reset your password by going to app.roosterly.nl/login and clicking "Wachtwoord vergeten" (Forgot password). Enter your email address there. The reset link is valid for 60 minutes. If you don't receive an email within 10 minutes, please check your spam folder.

Kind regards,
Team Roosterly
verified_en: Hi Marloes, You can reset your password by going to app.roosterly.nl/login and clicking "Wachtwoord vergeten" (Forgot password). Enter your email address there. The reset link is valid for 60 minutes. Do you not receive an email within 10 minutes? Then check your spam folder. Kind regards, Team Roosterly

subject: Nieuwe medewerker
reason: This is a standard how-to question fully answered by FAQ F02. Priority is P4 as it is a general how-to query.
draft_reply:
Hallo Anouk,

Je kunt een nieuwe medewerker toevoegen door als manager te gaan naar Team → Medewerker toevoegen. Vul daar de naam, het e-mailadres en de contracturen in en klik op Uitnodigen. De medewerker ontvangt vervolgens een e-mail om de app te installeren.

Met vriendelijke groet,
Team Roosterly
reply_en:
Hello Anouk,

As a manager, you can add a new employee by going to Team → Medewerker toevoegen (Add employee). Enter their name, email address, and contract hours, then click Uitnodigen (Invite). The employee will receive an email to install the app.

Best regards,
Team Roosterly
verified_en: Hello Anouk, You can add a new employee by going as a manager to Team → Medewerker toevoegen. Enter the name, email address and contract hours there and click Uitnodigen. The employee will then receive an email to install the app. Kind regards, Team Roosterly

subject: Export naar Loket
reason: The question is fully answered by the help centre (F04 and F05). Since the customer is on the Basis plan, they were informed that the Loket.nl integration requires the Plus plan.
draft_reply:
Hallo,

Roosterly kan goedgekeurde uren exporteren naar Loket.nl. Deze koppeling maakt onderdeel uit van het Plus-abonnement. Je kunt het abonnement op elk moment upgraden via Instellingen → Abonnement (Settings → Subscription).

Zodra je het Plus-abonnement hebt, kun je de koppeling instellen via Instellingen → Koppelingen → Salaris (Settings → Integrations → Payroll).

Met vriendelijke groet,
Team Roosterly
reply_en:
Hello,

Roosterly can export approved hours to Loket.nl. This integration is part of the Plus plan. You can upgrade your subscription at any time under Instellingen → Abonnement (Settings → Subscription).

Once you have the Plus plan, you can set up the integration under Instellingen → Koppelingen → Salaris (Settings → Integrations → Payroll).

Best regards,
Team Roosterly
verified_en: Hello, Roosterly can export approved hours to Loket.nl. This integration is part of the Plus plan. You can upgrade your subscription at any time via Settings → Subscription. As soon as you have the Plus plan, you can set up the integration via Settings → Integrations → Payroll. Kind regards, Team Roosterly

subject: Schichten tauschen
reason: This is a standard how-to question about swapping shifts fully covered by FAQ F03. Priority is P4 as it is an informational request.
draft_reply:
Hallo,

Mitarbeiter können eine Schicht in der App öffnen und auf "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap) tippen. Kolleginnen und Kollegen mit der gleichen Rolle können den Tausch dann akzeptieren. Der Manager genehmigt diesen anschließend unter Rooster → Verzoeken (Rota → Requests). Die Genehmigung durch den Manager ist standardmäßig aktiviert, kann aber unter Instellingen → Rooster (Settings → Rota) ausgeschaltet werden.

Viele Grüße
Team Roosterly
reply_en:
Hello,

Employees open the shift in the app and tap "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap). Colleagues with the same role can accept the swap. The manager approves it under Rooster → Verzoeken (Rota → Requests). Manager approval is on by default; you can turn it off under Instellingen → Rooster (Settings → Rota).

Best regards,
Team Roosterly
verified_en: Hello, Employees can open a shift in the app and tap "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap). Colleagues with the same role can then accept the swap. The manager subsequently approves this under Rooster → Verzoeken (Rota → Requests). Manager approval is enabled by default, but can be turned off under Instellingen → Rooster (Settings → Rota). Best regards, Team Roosterly
